title: How to Restore Old Photos with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Use a single natural-language request to let Claude upload an old photo, call the right Medux restoration workflow through MCP, monitor the task, and save the enhanced result locally.
operation: Use a single natural-language request to let Claude upload an old photo, call the right Medux restoration workflow through MCP, monitor the task, and save the enhanced result locally.
prompt: Restore Old Photo [your-photo.jpg]. Upload the file using a curl command.
